source: OSM extract download.openstreetmap.fr/europe/ukraine/kiev.osm.pbf (ODbL); terrain AWS Terrain Tiles / SRTM terrarium z=12; population WorldPop+DLR constrained 100 m 2020 v2 (CC BY)
note: Kyiv-city extract. Centroids binned at 250 m (2× refinement of the 500 m grid). Terrain is SRTM-class, ±10 m typical RMSE, not a lidar DSM. Building height = OSM height tag, else building:levels × 3 m, else a type prior (house 2, apartments 5, default 3).
popSource: WorldPop and DLR (2022). Gridded population estimates for Ukraine using UN COD-PS estimates 2020, version 2.0. Constrained 100 m, CC BY. https://data.worldpop.org/repo/wopr/UKR/v2/constrained/
popNote: Pre-war residential headcount, 2020. Not a 2022 wartime density — Kyiv emptied in March 2022 and only partially returned. Constrained to the DLR settlement layer; pixels outside OSM occupied cells are snapped to the nearest building cell. Ambient/residential, not hour-specific.
